name: Turki Alalshikh (private individual)
note: Bought 100% of The Ring Magazine in November 2024 in a personal deal (his own X post, 11 Nov 2024). Treated as state-linked: he is a Saudi government official (GEA chairman, adviser at the royal court), and the Guardian describes The Ring as 'the boxing magazine owned by Al-Sheikh and, by extension, the Saudi government' (Zidan, 1 Aug 2025).
